sentences.text: Milan Mondal vs Unknown on 25 February, 2026
Author: Tirthankar Ghosh Bench: Tirthankar Ghosh 25.02.2026

In re : An Application for Bail under Section 439 of the Code of  Criminal Procedure, 1973/under Section 483 of the BNSS, 2023 in  connection with Pathar Pratima Police Station Case No. 111 of 2022  dated 23.04.2022 u/s 498A/302/304B/34 of the IPC after being charge  sheeted under section 498A/325/316/304B/34 of the IPC.
 -And-

In the matter of : Milan Mondal  ... Petitioner  Mr. Malay Bhattacharyya  Mr. Pradip Paul  Ms. Renesa Dey  ... for the Petitioner(s)
 Mr. Md. Anowar Hossain  Mr. Atanu Ghosh  ... for the State-respondent(s)
Learned advocate for the petitioner submits that the petitioner is in custody for four years and there has been no progress in the trial since the earlier rejection.

Learned advocate for the State opposes the prayer for bail and submits that out of the 25 witnesses,
18 witnesses have already been completed and seven more witnesses - majority of whom are formal witnesses, are to be examined.
Having considered the advanced stage of the case, I am not inclined to enlarge the petitioner on bail.
Hence, the prayer for bail of the petitioner is Rejected.
Pending application(s), if any, is also disposed of.
Parties to act on a server copy of this order duly collected from the official website of the Hon'ble High Court, Calcutta.
